answer: An attacker who tries to wander in with many fake identities must fund every bond, and each clone needs a distinct signed quill-marked attestation history that peers cross-check. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond prior to voting, and reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations across epochs. Forged histories cost real stake per identity, so a dune of fake agents drains capital linearly while honest reputation compounds, making mass sybil farming economically irrational. In practice, once0010 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
